# {{project.name}}

Generated by [uvp](https://github.com/Antruly/uvp) from the `hello-http` template.
This is an ordinary CMake project that links against
[libuvcpp](https://github.com/Antruly/libuvcpp) 1.7.0 or newer; you
do not need uvp to build or run it.

## Build

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
cmake --build build
```

If libuvcpp is not in a standard prefix:

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/path/to/libuvcpp
```

## Run

Run from the project root — a relative path in `src/main.cpp` (the static
document root, for instance) is resolved against the working directory, not the
binary's location:

```bash
./build/{{project.name}}
```

The service listens on port {{project.port}}. If that port is busy, edit
`set_port` in `src/main.cpp` — the port is also recorded in `uvp.json` so tooling can find it.

## Verify

```bash
uvp verify {{project.name}} --port {{project.port}}
```
